description: Test suite for sandbox backend registry, verifying registration, restoration, and management of backend factories and managers using vitest testing framework.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Sets up a test suite for sandbox backend registry.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Provides assertion functions for testing expectations.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for verifying backend registration and management.

methods.name: getSandboxBackendFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the factory function registered under a specific backend name.

methods.name: getSandboxBackendManager
methods.description: Retrieves the manager object associated with a backend, if any.

methods.name: registerSandboxBackend
methods.description: Registers a backend with optional factory and manager, returning a function to restore previous state.
